name: arto
description: Use Arto, the Markdown reader, as Claude Code's display: open documents in front of the reader, follow what they read and select, and picture what Arto drew.

allow.title: Directories Claude may open
allow.description: Absolute paths of the directories Claude may open files under, separated by ':' (';' on Windows). Include the project if Claude should still open its files. Leave empty for the project only.
